content:
opening this thread to keep track (mostly for my sake) of some golfing & simplifying in the LTS files.
this mainly uses the symmetry of IsBisimulation: as it was, many of the proofs were effectively proving something about IsSimulation twice, so i've factored those results into the earlier file. this gets all the proofs under 30 lines barring the mega computation in IsBisimulation.traceEq_not_bisim.
not sure if i'll have time, but this could probably also be done in (at least) CCS.BehaviouralTheory and HML :)
